project.question: When can a learned representation support stable and reusable option discovery?
project.long_term_agenda: Continual option learning: construct, retain, adapt, and retire reusable temporal abstractions for changing tasks.
project.minimum_completion: A self-contained technical chapter with one formal separation and one validated diagnostic.

sprint.claim: Across controlled excitation levels, log condition number predicts affine recovery error more reliably than predictive loss.
sprint.artifact: A four-page note, results.csv, and one three-panel main figure.

active_experiment.question: Does conditioning beat predictive loss on held-out prediction?
active_experiment.hypothesis: K dominates L on held-out recovery prediction at matched sample size.
active_experiment.intervention: Train both predictors on the same runs; compare held-out R2.
active_experiment.measurement: Held-out predictive R2, K vs L, matched sample size.
active_experiment.kill_criterion: Stop the comparative claim if K wins on fewer than 4 of 5 seeds.
